description: Retrieval test set for Dai, Shao & Sheng (2024), 'An investigation into Venusian atmospheric chemistry based on an open-access photochemistry-transport model at 0-112 km' (A&A 689, A55). Used by scripts/compare_retrieval.py to compare retrieval strategies.
relevance_rule: A retrieved chunk counts as relevant if its text contains ALL phrases in must_contain (case-insensitive). Judging relevance by content rather than by hand-labelled chunk ids means the test set survives any change to chunk size, overlap, or segmentation - which would otherwise invalidate every label the moment the chunker is touched.

queries.question: What eddy diffusion coefficient Kzz value was used in the cloud layer?
queries.note: Numeric-value lookup - the case dense retrieval handles worst, since the embedding of a magnitude is nearly identical regardless of the number.

queries.question: Which existing photochemical model is this work built on?
queries.note: Rare proper noun: strong lexical signal, weak semantic signal.

queries.question: What altitude range does the model span?
queries.note: Numeric range stated in the abstract and model description.

queries.question: What novel mechanism eliminates O2 at 70 km?
queries.note: Conceptual question - dense retrieval should do well here.

queries.question: How does dissolution into cloud droplets affect SO2 abundance?
How is gas solubility in cloud droplets parameterised?
queries.note: The answer term ('Henry's law') never appears in the question - pure semantic bridge, where BM25 alone should fail.

queries.question: What boundary conditions were imposed at the top and bottom of the model domain?
Which observed species abundances does the model reproduce correctly?
queries.note: Broad question with many partially-relevant chunks.

queries.question: What is the primary reservoir of sulfur in the Venusian atmosphere?
queries.note: Direct factual lookup with a clear single answer.

queries.question: How are photolysis rates computed in the radiative transfer scheme?
